Subject: Annual commit options & per-token discounts

Hi Neha,

We are reviewing vendor options for our primary LLM endpoint and want to understand Redwood's annual commit options and how per-token volume discounts tier. Our use case is product search + chat for end users — we expect bursty spikes but a steady baseline. High-level asks: 
- Example tier levels you recommend for small / mid / large customers (annual tokens)
- Per-token pricing at list and at committed tiers (and any minimums)

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Annual commit options & per-token discounts

Hi Elena — thanks for the context and the snapshot. Quick overview below; I'll follow up with a short spreadsheet that lays out numbers and a draft SOW for procurement. If it helps, we can do a 30-min call early next week to walk through the assumptions.

High-level commit tiers (example):
- Starter: 50M annual tokens — good for small pilots / low-volume production
- Growth: 250M annual tokens — typical for scale across a product line
- Enterprise: 1B+ annual tokens — reserved capacity and the deepest discounts

Discounting model (per-token):
- List rate: $0.00012 / token (text gen, standard model)
- Starter commit: 10% off list for min 50M annual commit
- Growth commit: 20% off list for 250M annual commit + 10% usage tiered additional rebate over thresholds
- Enterprise commit: 30% off list for 1B+ commit, includes optional reserved capacity SLA and burst pool

Overages and flexibility:
- Quarterly reconciliation with a 60-day rollback window to reallocate unused commit to next quarter once per contract year
- Overage rate is list minus a contracted overage discount (usually 5%–10% better than list)

What I'm attaching: a draft worksheet with tier math and a preliminary SOW template for procurement.

If you can share a 6–12 month expected token ramp (even a coarse column), I'll refine the numbers and include a recommended staged migration plan with cost sensitivity.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Subject: Formal proposal — Growth / Growth+ / Enterprise options (annual commit)

Hi Elena — thanks for the forecasting doc and the call availability. Below is a concise proposal with concrete pricing and next steps; I've attached a clean SOW for procurement and a detailed worksheet with math.

Summary of options (annual committed tokens | effective per-token rate after discount | notes):
- Growth — 250,000,000 tokens | $0.000096 / token (20% off list $0.00012) | Quarterly reconciliation, 60-day carryover, standard throughput
- Growth+ (recommended) — 250,000,000 commit + 250,000,000 burst pool (pre-purchased credits) | blended $0.000088 / token on used credits (additional 8% blended benefit on burst usage) | Burst pool provides guaranteed capacity for marketing spikes; unused burst credits bill back at 50% refund if not consumed within 120 days
- Enterprise — 1,000,000,000 tokens | $0.000084 / token (30% off list) | Reserved capacity with 99.9% availability SLA, dedicated burst pool, dedicated onboarding support and quarterly business reviews

Overage policy:
- If you exceed the committed tokens in any quarter, overage is billed at list rate minus a 7% overage discount.
- We perform quarterly reconciliation and invoice/credit within 30 days of reconciliation.

Flexibility & credits:
- We can extend the carryover window to 90 days for Growth deals that include a 12-month notice clause (one-time concession for first-year onboarding).
- Refunds are not standard, but we offer crediting against future usage under a reconciliation model; for material underutilization (less than 50% of commit in year 1) we'll include a one-time credit equal to 25% of unused committed spend to support migration costs.

Next steps:
1) Sign the attached SOW (SOW-Draft-FinStart.pdf) and return with billing/legal contacts.
2) We'll provision a Growth+ pilot environment and set up usage dashboards; initial provisioning time is ~5 business days after signature.
3) Procurement and our legal team to review T&Cs (I can loop in our contracts lead).

Attachments: SOW-Draft-FinStart.pdf, Redwood_Commit_Tiers_v3.xlsx
